purpose: Exact arithmetic behind the prospective scale and analysis gates; this is not an execution allocation or an observed result.

reference_scale.note: 2^32 is a reference scale, not a prime in the execution manifest.

expected_event_arithmetic.interpretation: Expected-count arithmetic per cell under independent equal-rate proposals; it is not a specified-power sample size.

zero_event_bound.scope: One fixed-rate independent Bernoulli cell. Selection, clustering, overdispersion, censoring, and multiplicity require separate treatment.

profile_slope.sampling_model: S_i independently distributed Poisson(N_i * exp(alpha) * p_i^beta)
profile_slope.profile_log_likelihood_up_to_beta_indepe: ell_p(beta) = sum_i S_i * (log(N_i) + beta*log(p_i)) - S * log(sum_i N_i*p_i^beta), where S=sum_i S_i
profile_slope.boundary_mle: beta_hat=-infinity if every event is at the smallest p; beta_hat=+infinity if every event is at the largest p
profile_slope.sign_check: beta=-1 is the 1/p line; beta nearer zero is slower decay
profile_slope.role: Executable conditional-Poisson sensitivity; it does not replace the protocol-frozen binomial complementary-log-log model.

simultaneous_conservative_interval.method: Conditional Hoeffding inversion with a two-sided Bonferroni union bound
simultaneous_conservative_interval.prospectively_frozen_profile_count: M counts the joint Poisson, binomial-cloglog, and cluster-robust roster across both co-primary endpoints, stages, denominators, and unresolved allocations
simultaneous_conservative_interval.lower_bound: Solve mu(beta_L)=xbar-c; beta_L=-infinity when xbar-c <= min_i log(p_i)
simultaneous_conservative_interval.upper_bound: Solve mu(beta_U)=xbar+c; beta_U=+infinity when xbar+c >= max_i log(p_i)
simultaneous_conservative_interval.coverage_claim: At least 1-alpha simultaneously over the M prospectively counted profiles, conditional on their event totals, under the stated Poisson allocation model. Dependence between reported profiles does not invalidate the union bound.
simultaneous_conservative_interval.decision_use: analyze.py uses beta_L, not an asymptotic likelihood-ratio interval, for every admitted/proposed and all-failure/all-success curve-rank and useful-recovery Poisson profile in discovery and fresh replication.

frozen_model_and_cluster_gate.binomial_profile_lower: Profile alpha numerically; with z=Phi^-1(1-alpha_FWER/(2*M)), beta_L is the lower solution ell_p(beta_L)=ell_p(beta_hat)-z^2/2. This profile-likelihood bound is asymptotic and is retained as a sensitivity, not mislabeled finite-sample exact.
frozen_model_and_cluster_gate.cluster_bootstrap: Within each bit size, resample prime clusters with replacement; within each sampled prime, resample (source_id,curve_id) clusters with replacement; refit binomial cloglog in each replicate; take the empirical alpha_FWER/(2*M) lower quantile of signed beta.
frozen_model_and_cluster_gate.cluster_bootstrap_minimum_replicates: B >= ceil(2*M/alpha_FWER), so the Bonferroni tail contains at least one empirical order-statistic slot. Production rejects smaller B; tiny B is permitted only by a non-CLI synthetic-test override.
frozen_model_and_cluster_gate.cluster_bootstrap_caveat: The hierarchical bootstrap is a predeclared overdispersion sensitivity, not an exact finite-sample coverage theorem. The conditional Poisson Hoeffding inversion remains the explicitly finite-sample-conservative interval under its model.
co_primary_endpoints: certified nontrivial selected-point relation with invertible target coefficient and exact scalar replay
frozen_model_and_cluster_gate.separation_rule: Curve rank >= r does not imply selected-point independence or failed recovery; the endpoints have independent YES/NO/UNKNOWN classifications.
frozen_model_and_cluster_gate.artifact_binding: The separately frozen sensitivity artifact must match the exact canonical row-set SHA-256 and PROTOCOL.md SHA-256, match the local sensitivity.py SHA-256, match the trusted FREEZE.json SHA-256, contain the complete profile roster, and equal executable recomputation.
frozen_model_and_cluster_gate.semantic_freeze_binding: FREEZE.json must independently fix familywise alpha, total simultaneous hypothesis count, both endpoints, both denominators, both unresolved allocations, all three methods, cluster keys, cluster method, replicate count, and cluster seed. A digest reference without these matching semantics is rejected.
frozen_model_and_cluster_gate.fail_closed_rule: No DEFEATED_IN_SCOPE decision is possible when the artifact is absent, incomplete, digest-mismatched, or has any required signed-beta lower bound <= -0.8.

open_hard_gates.mixed_unresolved_allocation: Uniform all-failure and all-success corners do not bound a slope: allocating unknown successes at low p and failures at high p can be worse. Production DEFEATED_IN_SCOPE is hard-blocked until every required model rigorously minimizes its signed-beta lower bound over S_i in [A_i,A_i+U_i].
open_hard_gates.raw_provenance: Production DEFEATED_IN_SCOPE is hard-blocked until rows are executable-bound to the frozen roster, prime manifest, stage seeds, and actual raw rank-adapter and relation-certificate digests. Self-declared JSON identifiers are insufficient.
open_hard_gates.relation_inventory: A replayed false, trivial, or noninvertible candidate does not establish absence of another useful relation. Production is hard-blocked until every proposal and coexistence class is inventoried under a deterministic any-useful rule, with exact proof digests; ranked non-successes otherwise remain UNKNOWN.
open_hard_gates.public_private_boundary: The selector and relation-proposal processes must consume a hash-linked redacted public record containing no source or target scalars. The private evaluator may use them only for exact replay. A self-declared uses_source_scalars=false field is not an enforceable anti-circularity boundary.
open_hard_gates.natural_executor: The deterministic runner plans rosters and exercises control interfaces, but it intentionally has no natural-row executor until relation/recovery integration, complete work accounting, and the evidence bindings above exist.
open_hard_gates.test_overrides: Internal synthetic tests can exercise downstream Boolean logic with explicitly named test-only overrides. No CLI exposes those overrides, and any output records when they were active.

decision_scale_caveats: The JKSST/Silverman analysis contains height and coefficient constants; kappa=1 is a transparent scale calculation, not a theorem-derived constant.
Thirty expected events is not thirty observed certified nontrivial useful recoveries.
No high-bit factorial run is claimed to be affordable by these numbers.
No natural rank or recovery row, binomial-cloglog sensitivity, or cluster-robust sensitivity is bundled with this file.
